# Debug the full pipeline including slugify
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags
from html import unescape
from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])
md_text = r"# escaped\\_character"

print("Input:", repr(md_text))

html = md.convert(md_text)
print("\\nHTML:", html)

for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"\\nel.text: {repr(el.text)}")
        print(f"el.text chars: {[ord(c) for c in el.text]}")
        
        inner_html = render_inner_html(md, el)
        processed_text = run_postprocessors(md, inner_html)
        text = striptags(processed_text)
        print(f"text after striptags: {repr(text)}")
        print(f"chars: {[ord(c) for c in text]}")
        
        unescaped = unescape(text)
        print(f"after unescape: {repr(unescaped)}")
        
        # Check what self.slugify would be
        result = slugify(unescaped, "-", False)
        print(f"slugify result: {repr(result)}")
        break
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-200:])
